text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Small... Small... Small, small, small!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even so, I will—! Yaaaaaaarrrrghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Uuuugh... I won... But I can't brag about 
this at all... I just feel pathetic and 
frustrated—)

Even with her face twisted in bitter pain, 
Mejiro Palmer pushed through with an 
all-out run to seize the victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen... and Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. Um... how should I put 
it~ That was some really tenacious 
running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Ordinarily, this was a great feat I 
wished to achieve with my own hands. Even 
so..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If it was you, a fellow Mejiro, who pulled 
it off, then that takes some of the sting 
out of my frustration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to apologize. You won 
fair and square through your own 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's not what I mean...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for being so selfish. I'm sorry 
I can't just be completely selfish. How 
should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to run more as Mejiro Palmer! As 
myself! Everyone else got to do that!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Anyway... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I do not know either. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She may seem easygoing and frank, but she 
has moments like that from time to time, 
doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's quite complex and delicate. 
It's just that I haven't quite figured it 
out myself...
That night—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, hey, what's wrong...? Need me 
to cheer you up?

That night, Mejiro Palmer looked gloomy 
the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, BFF, you know, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda light, you know...? And, 
well... it's small.

Mejiro Palmer looked up at the ceiling and 
let out a soft sigh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to be bound by the Mejiro 
name. I thought that and tried to just be 
myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how serious McQueen looked made me 
wonder... If she's not doing this for the 
Mejiros, who is it for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For my freedom. That's what I decided, 
but... Then what is that freedom for? Just 
plain selfishness? Or is there another 
reason?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't know for sure, but the reason is— 
Could I really be proud of this in front 
of McQueen? Could I stand alongside her? I 
just started wondering that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it was because it was the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)... Because it's a race so special 
to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to get myself back, even just a 
little... To do that, next, I need to...

Such a gloomy mood. What's best to liven 
things up is... a festival race, of 
course. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally running the Takarazuka 
Kinen!!!!!

The one who spoke up with a voice full of 
anguish was Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My bestie can run with way more fun! She's 
not done yet, she's gonna get super hyped, 
let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If it's a festival race where all the 
casuals can get totally hyped up! That's 
why...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right. If it's the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Sounds good. Let's go with that.

text_block_list.text: I give a small nod. And then—

"Let's take another look before the 
Takarazuka Kinen. At Mejiro Palmer's true 
feelings and passion for racing."
